name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowship
health_fields_eligible: Public Health; Healthcare Management (not clinical MD residency)
grade_requirement: 55% or above in bachelor's from a recognised Indian university
notes: J-1 visa carries a 2-year home-country return requirement

name: Chevening Scholarship
notes: Requires admission offer from a UK university in parallel

name: Commonwealth Scholarship (Shared/Distance Learning)
notes: Focused on development-relevant study; check field list each cycle

name: DAAD EPOS (Development-Related Postgraduate Courses)
grade_requirement: Good academic record; degree not older than 6 years
notes: Monthly stipend approx EUR 992 (Master's) per DAAD 2026 figures

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (Global Health tracks)
notes: Only some consortia offer health/public-health tracks; verify per intake

name: Australia Awards Scholarship
notes: Health is listed as a priority development sector for India

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford)
notes: Covers Stanford MD program directly; extremely selective (~1% admit)

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
notes: Embassy and university tracks both available

name: National Overseas Scholarship (Govt of India - MoSJE)
health_fields_eligible: Any field including Medicine (subject to category eligibility)
notes: Income and category ceilings apply; cannot combine with Fulbright-Nehru

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
notes: Research-focused; not a route to clinical MD training

name: Islamic Development Bank Merit Scholarship
grade_requirement: Strong academic record; OIC member country nationals
notes: Priority given to science and technology fields including health
